principles: 1) AGENTS IDENTIFICATION - Textual Rules ----------------------------------------------- -> If BICFI is present, then (Name & Postal Address) is NOT allowed (ClearingSystemMemberIdentification and LEI may complement) – However, in case of conflicting information, the BICFI will always take precedence. -> If BICFI is absent, (Name & Postal Address) OR [(Name & Postal Address) and ClearingSystemMemberIdentification] must be present. Exception: If BICFI is absent, whenever Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are located within the same country, the clearing code only may be used. 2) Character Set: All proprietary and Text fields EXCLUDING Name and Address for all actors and Related Remittance Information and Remittance are limited to the FIN-X-Character set. All Name and Address for all actors, Related Remittance Information and Remittance Information (structured and unstructured), Email Address where included as part of a proxy element are extended to support the following additional characters: !#$%&*=^_`{|}~";<>@[\] < is replaced with < > is replaced with >

format_constraints.name: Priority
format_constraints.cbpr_restricted_type: One of the following code values must be used:

format_constraints.name: Priority
format_constraints.cbpr_restricted_type: One of the following code values must be used:

business_rules.name: CBPR_BusinessMessageIdentifier_FormalRule
business_rules.description: The Business Message Identifier must match the Message Identification in the Group Header.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [Full Message], every occurrence of [FullMessage/BusinessApplicationHeaderV02/BusinessMessageIdentifier] value must be equal to every occurrence of [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/GroupHeader/MessageIdentification] value

business_rules.name: CBPR_Related_Business_Application_Header_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If used, the Related BAH must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message.

business_rules.name: CBPR_BusinessMessageIdentifier_TextualRule
business_rules.description: The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this element must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

business_rules.name: CBPR_MessageDefinitionIdentifier_TextualRule
business_rules.description: The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.

business_rules.name: CBPR_RelatedBAHBusinessService_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If related BAH is present, then it is recommended to transport the element Business Service.

business_rules.name: CBPR_GroupHeader_TotalChargesAmount_Sum_FormalRule
business_rules.description: TotalChargesAmount present in GroupHeader/TotalCharges must equal the sum of all occurrences of Charges/PerTransaction/Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/ TotalChargesAmount.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03], every occurrence of [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/GroupHeader/TotalCharges/TotalChargesAmount] value must be equal to the sum of all occurences of the following element(s) [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/TotalChargesAmount]

business_rules.name: CBPR_GroupHeader_NumberOfChargesRecords_FormalRule
business_rules.description: The value of GroupHeader/TotalCharges/NumberOfChargesRecords must be equal to the number of occurrences of Charges/PerTransaction/Record.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03], every occurrence of [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/GroupHeader/TotalCharges/NumberOfChargesRecords] value must be equal to the number of occurrences of [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record]

business_rules.name: CBPR_GroupHeader_TotalChargesAmount_Currency_FormalRule
business_rules.description: The currency used in every occurrence of GroupHeader/TotalCharges/TotalChargesAmount must be equal to the currency used in every occurrence of Charges/PerTransaction/Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/ TotalChargesAmount.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03], for each [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03], every occurrence of [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/GroupHeader/TotalCharges/TotalChargesAmount/Currency] must have the same value than every occurrence of [ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/TotalChargesAmount/Currency]

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_National_only_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Whenever all agents in the chain are located within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Option_2_TextualRule
business_rules.description: (Clearing Code OR LEI) AND (Name AND ([Structured postal address with minimum Town Name and Country] OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country]). It is recommended to also add the post code when available

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Option_1_TextualRule
business_rules.description: BICFI, complemented optionally with a LEI (preferred option)

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Option_3_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Name AND ([Structured postal address with minimum Town Name and Country] OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country]). It is recommended to also add the post code when available

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Name_Postal_Address_FormalRule
business_rules.description: Name and Address must always be present together.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/GroupHeader/ChargesAccountOwner/FinancialInstitutionIdentification], for each [FinancialInstitutionIdentification], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/Name] is (are) present then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/PostalAddress] must be present and for each [FinancialInstitutionIdentification], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/PostalAddress] is (are) present then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/Name] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Duplication_Postal_Address_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Data present in structured elements within the Postal Address must not, under any circumstances be repeated in AddressLine.

business_rules.name: CBPR_ChargeIdentification_FormalRule
business_rules.description: This element must not start or end with a slash '/' and must not contain two consecutive slashes '//'.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/ChargesIdentification], the value of every occurrence of [ChargesIdentification] must not comply with the following XML pattern : '(/.*)|(.*/)|(.*//.*)'

business_rules.name: CBPR_Record_TotalChargeAmount_Sum_FormalRule
business_rules.description: TotalChargesAmount present in Record/TotalChargesPerRecord must equal the sum of all occurrences of Record/ChargesBreakdown/Amount.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record], every occurrence of [Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/TotalChargesAmount] value must be equal to the sum of all occurences of the following element(s) [Record/ChargesBreakdown/Amount]

business_rules.name: CBPR_Record_ChargesBreakdownAmount_Currency_FormalRule
business_rules.description: The currency used in every occurrence of Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/TotalChargesAmount must be equal to the currency used in every occurrence of Record/ChargesBreakdown/Amount.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record], every occurrence of [Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/TotalChargesAmount/Currency] value must be equal to every occurrence of [Record/ChargesBreakdown/Amount/Currency] value

business_rules.name: CBPR_Record_NumberOfChargesBreakdownItems_FormalRule
business_rules.description: Charges/PerTransaction/Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/ NumberOfChargesBreakdownItems must equal the number of occurrences of Charges/PerTransaction/Record/ChargesBreakdown.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record], every occurrence of [Record/TotalChargesPerRecord/NumberOfChargesBreakdownItems] value must be equal to the number of occurrences of [Record/ChargesBreakdown]

business_rules.name: CBPR_Record_MessageNameIdentification_InstructionIdentification_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If “Message Name Identification” is populated with pacs.008 or pacs.009 or MT103/202/205, then InstructionIdentification is mandatory.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record], if the value of every occurrence of [Record/UnderlyingTransaction/MessageNameIdentification] complies with the following XML pattern : 'pacs\.00[89]\.001\.[0-9]{2}|MT103|MT202|MT205' , then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [Record/UnderlyingTransaction/InstructionIdentification] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_MessageNameIdentification_UETR_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If “Message Name Identification” is populated with pacs.008 or pacs.009 or MT103/202/205, then UETR is mandatory.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record], if the value of every occurrence of [Record/UnderlyingTransaction/MessageNameIdentification] complies with the following XML pattern : 'pacs\.00[89]\.001\.[0-9]{2}|MT103|MT202|MT205' , then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [Record/UnderlyingTransaction/UETR] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Name_Postal_Address_FormalRule
business_rules.description: Name and Address must always be present together.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/ChargesRequestor/FinancialInstitutionIdentification], for each [FinancialInstitutionIdentification], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/Name] is (are) present then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/PostalAddress] must be present and for each [FinancialInstitutionIdentification], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/PostalAddress] is (are) present then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/Name] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Record_UnderlyingTransaction_Presence_FormalRule
business_rules.description: In Underlying Transaction, in addition to the "Message Name Identification", one other identification must be provided.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/UnderlyingTransaction], if the following element(s) [UnderlyingTransaction/MessageIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/AccountServicerReference] and [UnderlyingTransaction/PaymentInformationIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/InstructionIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/EndToEndIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/UETR] and [UnderlyingTransaction/TransactionIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/MandateIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/ChequeNumber] and [UnderlyingTransaction/AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification] and [UnderlyingTransaction/AccountServicerTransactionIdentification] is (are) absent , then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [UnderlyingTransaction/ProcessingIdentification] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Instruction_Identification_FormalRule
business_rules.description: This element must not start or end with a slash '/' and must not contain two consecutive slashes '//'.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/UnderlyingTransaction/InstructionIdentification], the value of every occurrence of [InstructionIdentification] must not comply with the following XML pattern : '(/.*)|(.*/)|(.*//.*)'

business_rules.name: CBPR_Debtor_Option_3_Jurisdictions_only_TextualRule
business_rules.description: For Jurisdictional transactions, Debtor/ Name is mandatory with either Debtor Account OR Debtor Identification (that is within a country or for regions under same legislations – eg EEA) Countries impacted by the Jurisdictional rule: Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Croatia, Italy, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Hungary, Malta, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland, Sweden - Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway. Note: The jurisdictional rules apply only when all agents in the payment chain underly the same jurisdiction.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Debtor_BIC_Presence_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If Any BIC is present, then (Name and Postal Address) is NOT allowed (other elements remain optional) - However, in case of conflicting information, AnyBIC will always take precedence.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Debtor_Option_1_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Organisation Identification/AnyBIC AND (Account Number OR Organisation Identification/Other)

business_rules.name: CBPR_Debtor_Option_2_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Name AND ([Structured Address with minimumTown Name & Country (+ recommended to add Post code when available)]OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country (+ recommended to add Post code when available)] AND (Account Number OR Identification: Private or Organisation)

business_rules.name: CBPR_Party_Name_Postal_Address_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If Postal Address is present then Name is mandatory.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/Debtor], at least one occurrence of [Debtor/Name] must be present when at least one occurrence of [Debtor/PostalAddress] is present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Party_Name_Any_BIC_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If AnyBIC is absent then Name is mandatory and it is recommended to also provide the Postal Address.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/Debtor], at least one occurrence of [Debtor/Name] must be present when [Debtor/Identification/OrganisationIdentification/AnyBIC] is absent

business_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Name_Postal_Address_FormalRule
business_rules.description: Name and Address must always be present together.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/ChargesPaymentNotificationV03/Charges/PerTransaction/Record/DebtorAgent/FinancialInstitutionIdentification], for each [FinancialInstitutionIdentification], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/Name] is (are) present then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/PostalAddress] must be present and for each [FinancialInstitutionIdentification], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/PostalAddress] is (are) present then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [FinancialInstitutionIdentification/Name] must be present
